analysis.reasonEn: Previous two sessions maintained a wait-and-see stance. RSI slightly declined from 47.9 to 46.6, continuing consolidation in the neutral zone. MACD histogram at 4.1768 shows insufficient improvement. The 5-day low > 20-day low pattern persists, but low volume (0.85x) indicates a lack of momentum for trend reversal. ADX at 15.6 signifies a non-trending phase. Despite QQQ's intraday drop, the stock itself is consolidating near the support level ($522.24) without clear signs of a bearish turn.

· 현재가($529.47) vs SMA5($547.27)/SMA20($528.61)/SMA50($560.97) — 단기 하회, 중기 하회, 중기 저항 구간 진단

[모멘텀 지표]
· RSI 궤적 (47.9→46.6) + 중립 구간 지속 중 진단 + 하락 방향성 유지
· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (4.1768→4.1768) + 개선 미흡 진단 + 추세 전환 신호 부재
· 볼린저밴드 현재가 위치 (중단 $528.61) + 밴드폭 17.80%로 변동성 축소 구간
[지지·저항 구조]
· 스윙 지지선 ($522.24) + 피벗(PP $519.86) 기반 지지 구간
· 스윙 저항선 ($533.74) + SMA20($528.61)와 근접한 저항 구간
· 5일 고가($566.02)/저가($523.03), 20일 고가($566.02)/저가($464.08) — Higher Low 패턴 유지, 횡보 국면
[거래량·결론]
· 거래량 비율 (0.85배) + 움직임의 신뢰도 위축
· 현 구간 진단 (축적구간) + 지지선($522.24) 확인 시 관망, 저항선($533.74) 돌파 시 매수 고려 조건
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($529.47) vs SMA5 ($547.27)/SMA20 ($528.61)/SMA50 ($560.97) — Diagnosed below short-term and mid-term averages, testing mid-term resistance zone.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($511.58)/SMA200 ($417.25) — Maintaining mid-to-long-term trend strength.
· 52-week position (69.8%) + Current price level approximately 19% below historical highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (47.9→46.6) + Diagnosed as continued neutral zone + Maintaining downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (4.1768→4.1768) + Diagnosed as lacking improvement + Absence of trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Mid-band $528.61) + Bandwidth at 17.80% indicates reduced volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support level ($522.24) + Support based on Pivot Point (PP $519.86).
· Swing resistance level ($533.74) + Resistance zone near SMA20 ($528.61).
· 5-day high ($566.02)/low ($523.03), 20-day high ($566.02)/low ($464.08) — Higher Low pattern maintained, indicating consolidation.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.85x) + Reduced confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation zone) + Wait-and-see if support ($522.24) holds, consider buying on breakout above resistance ($533.74).
